column1: # Specific (font, layout, direction, justification) combinations for which the original figlet 2.2.5
# produces unusable output: it aborts (SIGABRT/SIGSEGV) or emits nondeterministic garbage with random
# control or non-ASCII bytes (it reads uninitialized memory).
# Source: full diagnostic sweeps of 2026-10-16 over every font, layout, direction, justification and 10
# generated texts, one figlet execution per combination and text, no retries - see
# plans/figlet-cli-comparison-harness-fix.md. The defects depend on the rendered text and on the output
# width: figlet breaks when the text fits in one line (-w = maxLength * text length, like the harness)
# and often exits 0 when the output wraps. All the other combinations stay under comparison.
# Follow-up single-character sweeps of 2026-10-17: with kerning or smushing and forced right-to-left,
# figlet 2.2.5 garbles the output of 423 of 660 fonts for single-character texts (and for %-leading
# texts on some fonts, e.g. 3-d), invisible to the original sweep whose texts were all 3+ characters.
# The HorizontalSmushing rows are mirrored as FontDefault rows: the harness maps the FontDefault
# layout to the same figlet flag (-s), so both options run the identical CLI invocation.
# font|layout|direction|justification|issue   (issue: sigabrt = figlet aborts, garbage = random bytes)
